requirements.requirement: Review before presenting designs, including drafts
Judge purpose, simplicity, coherent form and unseen surfaces

aesthetic_checks.observation: Long horizontal mango body, flowing S neck, intact long bill and lateral hips remain legible in hero and side drawings.
Shown shoe crowns are uninterrupted domes; leg and neck covers use rounded tapered surfaces rather than the slab-like 053 forms.
The three shoe divisions and lower neck cuff split are absent; ankle outlines, soles and corresponding mid-neck articulation boundaries remain.
Camera and bill form the visual focus; joint circles and ventilation slots are restrained repeated details; no arbitrary paint islands are present.
Hero, side, rear and foot detail share the revised shoe and neck boundary logic. An AI sheet does not prove common CAD projection or exact geometry.
No complete front/top/underside/inboard or moving-state evidence is provided; complete exterior and motion claims remain barred.

requirements.requirement: Reject and revise work that fails the aesthetic requirement

rejection_reasons: Thick slab-like neck and leg forms

requirements.requirement: Keep aesthetic judgment separate from engineering qualification

source_retention: The rejected 053 native geometry remains a local failed prototype and is not part of the published engineering package; its diagnostic render is retained here for the aesthetic disposition.
non_claims: Future subjective judgment is not mechanically guaranteed by a JSON file. The owner must perform the review each time.
No manufacturing, complete 360-degree exterior, motion, or new physical-version approval is granted.
The current illustrated form is provisional and does not silently replace native CAD.
